text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both posting modest gains near $79k and $2,500 respectively, with nearly identical 24-hour momentum suggesting aligned strength rather than divergence. The Fear & Greed index at 73 (Greed) and surging 42 points over a week signals a rapid shift from neutral to optimistic sentiment, though modest altcoin gains imply this optimism is concentrated in the majors. Bitcoin dominance holding steady at 59% combined with $102B in daily volume indicates solid participation without panic or euphoric capitulation.
